in_marathi.name: Milita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Milita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Milita is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘militā’, which means ‘goddess of war’. This name is associated with the goddess Durga, who is known for her fierce and protective nature. Milita is a powerful name that represents strength, courage, and the ability to overcome challenges.
